interface.signature: dict: List[str], N: int, K: int -> str

preconditions.description: The number of words in the dictionary is between 1 and 300.
The number of starting alphabets is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 50 for word in dict)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary has a length between 1 and 50.

postconditions.description: The returned string contains exactly K characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in return_value for char in set(''.join(dict)))
postconditions.description: The returned string contains all unique characters present in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(a) < return_value.index(b) for a, b in zip(dict[i], dict[i+1]) if a != b)
postconditions.description: The returned string respects the lexicographical order of the words in the dictionary.
